recent_articles.title: ‘Needless fuss’: Kerala CM V.D. Satheesan defends posting former State poll chief Rathan Kelkar as his Secretary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** stated that the appointment of **Rathan U. Kelkar**, former Chief Electoral Officer (Kerala), as his Secretary was not a cause for concern and dismissed criticisms from the opposition.  He emphasized that no political party in Kerala had accused Mr. Kelkar of election manipulation, noting that he was appointed by the previous CPI(M)-led LDF government. **Mr. Satheesan** further highlighted that Mr. Kelkar's appointment is not comparable to similar controversies in West Bengal where allegations against the CEO were made.

recent_articles.title: Former Kerala Chief Electoral Officer Rathan U. Kelkar takes charge as Secretary to CM Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rathan U. Kelkar**, former Chief Electoral Officer of Kerala, assumed the role of Secretary to **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan**.  The appointment has been met with criticism from the **CPI(M)** and **BJP**, who accuse the Congress of rewarding officials for election results. However, **Congress** leaders defend the decision, highlighting **Kelkar's** reputation as an efficient officer.

recent_articles.title: Rural roads in Belagavi to be developed under Pragatipath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Belagavi Zilla Panchayat** will construct 481.14 km of rural roads in the district under the **State government’s Pragatipath scheme**, costing ₹350 crore. The project, funded by a loan from the **Asian Development Bank** and a state share, aims to improve rural connectivity and is being overseen by the **Karnataka Rural Road Development Corporation**.  The first phase of construction will involve 230.54 km at a cost of ₹163 crore.

recent_articles.title: Congress factions in Kerala ‘wishcasting’ for their respective loyalists as KPCC president’s post comes up for grabs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** factions in Kerala are engaged in a power struggle for the upcoming KPCC president position, with **Sunny Joseph**, current KPCC president, joining the government. The **All India Congress Committee (AICC)** is reportedly set to intervene and re-organize the party's leadership structure, including the KPCC presidency, amidst concerns about internal divisions hindering past UDF governments.  The AICC has emphasized social demographics, caste balance, and merit as key considerations for selecting the next KPCC president.

recent_articles.title: Pinarayi flays crackdown on Cockroach Janta Party - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pinarayi Vijayan**, leader of the Opposition, criticized the **Union government's** withholding of the **Cockroach Janta Party’s X handle**. He argued that this action reflects intolerance towards democratic protests and suggests fear of the youth movement becoming a political force.  Vijayan stated that the platform has gained significant traction due to its focus on addressing unemployment and inequality, highlighting the deep discontent among young people.

recent_articles.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai booked over ‘objectionable’ comment on PM Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, **Uttar Pradesh Congress president**, is facing an FIR after a complaint from **Neeraj Kumar Rawat**, a BJP district working committee member, alleging abusive remarks against **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.  The complaint claims that Mr. Rai obstructed government work and blocked a public road with his convoy of vehicles and supporters. The police registered the case based on a video circulating online showing Mr. Rai making objectionable statements. Mr. Rai denies the allegations, calling it a tactic to silence him and accusing the BJP government of using state apparatus against opponents.

recent_articles.title: Back Rahul Gandhi’s call for ‘Samvidhan Bachao’, says Jagga Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T. Jagga Reddy**, a senior Congress leader, defended **Rahul Gandhi**'s "Samvidhan Bachao" campaign, arguing that the Constitution and democratic values are under threat under the current BJP-led government. He compared the Constitution to Karna's armor in the Mahabharata, stating that its protection is vital for citizens' rights and freedoms.  He called for vigilance to safeguard voting rights and constitutional freedoms, highlighting Congress contributions to India's democratic systems throughout history.

recent_articles.title: 'Go home' for Green Card rule: Immigration attorney Rahul Reddy explains what H-1B visa holders should do now - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **USCIS** has issued a new memo that requires individuals seeking Green Cards to apply for visas in their home countries instead of adjusting status within the United States. The memo, which experts say may be challenged in court, emphasizes that approving Green Card applications from within the US is a "favor" and not a right.  The memo's impact on those who have already filed Green Card applications remains unclear, but it suggests individuals with pending I-140 petitions should consult legal counsel to strengthen their case.

recent_articles.title: I am from India but none of my firm partners is Indian: Attorney Rahul Reddy counters hate on social media - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Reddy**, an immigration attorney, and **Emily Neumann**, a partner at his firm, the Reddy-Neumann Brown PC, addressed concerns about the "Indians only hire Indians" narrative circulating on social media. They emphasized that while fraud exists within the H-1B program, it does not represent the entire process or all individuals involved.  **Dr. Sean Wang**, a Chinese-American assistant professor, also filed a lawsuit against **Southern Methodist University**, alleging preferential treatment of Indian employees by head of the department **Dr. Hemang Desai**.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar challenges BJP leaders to travel by public transport daily - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, criticized **BJP** leaders for using public transport only for photoshoots in response to the Prime Minister's call for austerity measures. He challenged them to travel by public transport daily, questioning the sincerity of their actions.  He also addressed the Prime Minister's call to abstain from buying gold and expressed his commitment to visit Delhi when called upon by **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Cabinet expansion LIVE: Congress set to join Tamil Nadu’s first coalition government in decades - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay** is set to expand his Cabinet with the oath of office for 23 new ministers scheduled for Thursday, May 21, 2026.  The ceremony will take place at **Lok Bhavan**. The Congress party, which won five seats in the alliance led by the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, is joining the coalition government. **Thol. Thirumavalavan**, leader of the VCK, and the **IUML** have been invited to join the Council of Ministers.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Indian economy: Why Modi wants Indians to buy less gold and travel less
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged Indians to reduce their consumption of gold, foreign travel, fuel, and other goods as the war in Iran has led to increased energy prices.  The appeal, delivered at a public event in Hyderabad on Sunday, comes amid concerns about India's economic vulnerability due to its heavy reliance on imported oil and gas. The country's forex reserves have fallen by $38 billion since the war began, and economists warn that continued pressure on the rupee could lead to further economic hardship.  **Modi** is asking Indians to voluntarily consume less in the national interest, but some economists argue that shielding consumers from price increases will worsen shortages and slow down the transition to renewable energy sources.

recent_articles.title: Compromised PM didn't sign trade deal with U.S., but a bargain for Adani's release: Rahul - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** accused **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** of negotiating a trade deal with the U.S. to secure the release of billionaire businessman **Gautam Adani**.  The **U.S.** government agreed to settle a lawsuit against **Adani**, who was accused of bribery in connection with a solar energy project. Congress general secretary in-charge communications **Jairam Ramesh** criticized the deal, suggesting it was a "bargain" for **Adani's release".

recent_articles.title: Congress leader and former Jharkhand Minister, Alamgir Alam, walks out of jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Alamgir Alam**, a former Jharkhand minister, was released on bail from the Birsa Munda Central Jail in Ranchi after the Supreme Court granted relief in his money laundering case.  The **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** arrested **Alam** and his OSD, Sanjiv Kumar Lal, in 2024 following the seizure of nearly ₹32.20 crore from a flat linked to them. The Congress party fielded Alam's wife, Nishat Alam, as their candidate for the Pakur Assembly constituency in the 2024 elections, where she won. **Babulal Marandi**, the Leader of Opposition in the Jharkhand Assembly, criticized the celebration surrounding Alam's release, stating that it was premature and did not equate to an acquittal. He emphasized that the trial is ongoing and the legal process will continue until a final verdict is reached.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: BJP targets DMK leader Udhayanidhi Stalin over Sanatana Dharma remarks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** condemned **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, a DMK leader, for his remarks on Sanatana Dharma in the Tamil Nadu Assembly.  **G. Kishan Reddy**, Union Minister for Coal and Mines, accused the DMK of "poisonous politics" and "anti-Hindu rhetoric." The BJP also criticized the Congress party's support for Stalin's comments and questioned **Vijay**, the newly elected Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, on his silence regarding the issue.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. The dissidents have announced their intention to support the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government.  The Palaniswami camp claims that all 47 legislators gave written consent for **Edappadi K. Palaniswami** as the AIADMK legislature party leader, citing a Supreme Court verdict in the Shiv Sena case. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 26-year-old Indian tourist, **Kushagra Agarwal**, died at a Phuket cafe after collapsing on May 9th.  **The Indian embassy** is providing support to his family and is working with Thai authorities investigating the incident. Three other members of the group also fainted at the same cafe, one in a coma and two requiring further treatment. Police are looking into possible illicit substances or alcohol as a contributing factor but have not released any findings.

recent_articles.title: What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 26-year-old Indian tourist, Kushagra Agarwal, died at a Phuket cafe after collapsing and three others fainted simultaneously. The incident occurred on May 9th and the **Indian embassy** is providing support to the deceased's family.  The four men were reportedly at a cafe around 11 pm before losing consciousness one by one. Two of the men remain in a coma, while the remaining three are reported as stable. Police are investigating but have not released any conclusions about the cause of the incident.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: India’s Hindu extremist group RSS lobbies foreign groups to counter minority rights criticism - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**, a Hindu nationalist group linked to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, has organized foreign visits to the US, Germany, and Britain to counter accusations of being a paramilitary organization involved in attacks on minority communities. The **US Commission on International Religious Freedom** previously reported that the RSS has been involved in acts of violence against minorities for decades.  The group claims it is a "Hindu-centric civilisational, cultural movement" with goals of uniting Hindus and protecting their religion.  **Dattatreya Hosabale**, the RSS general secretary, met with policymakers and business leaders during his visits to dispel misconceptions about the organization.

recent_articles.title: Siddaramaiah launches counter-attack, accuses Modi of destroying dignity of Prime Minister’s post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for his recent speech in Bengaluru, accusing him of using "lies, poor taste, hatred and jealousy" to undermine the Prime Minister's office.  **Siddaramaiah** questioned the authenticity of the speech, suggesting it reflected poorly on **Modi**'s government and party in Karnataka.

recent_articles.title: Iran war: PM Modi urges Indians to work from home, limit foreign travel
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged Indians to embrace working from home, limit foreign travel, and reduce fuel consumption due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East.  His appeal, made at a public event in Hyderabad, aims to conserve foreign exchange as India heavily relies on imports for oil. The measures are reminiscent of those implemented during the Covid-19 pandemic, with **Modi** suggesting public transport usage and carpooling to reduce fuel use.  Analysts suggest these actions may be part of a government directive to curb energy consumption and potentially raise petroleum prices. Opposition leaders criticized **Modi's** remarks as an attempt to shift responsibility onto citizens rather than address the underlying issues.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Government formation LIVE: Impasse over chief ministerial candidate in Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leadership held marathon discussions in **New Delhi** with the three main contenders for Kerala's Chief Minister position, **K.C. Venugopal**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **V.D. Satheesan**, and **KPCC president Sunny Joseph**.  The consultations, attended by observers **Ajay Maken** and **Mukul Wasnik**, have failed to reach a decision on the selection of a new Chief Minister despite discussions lasting over three hours.

recent_articles.title: ‘Compromised PM’ no longer capable of running country: Rahul slams Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress**, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for urging citizens to make sacrifices during the West Asia conflict, calling it evidence of failure.  Gandhi argued that these measures are shifting responsibility onto the public and highlight the government's inability to address the crisis. The **Congress** also condemned **Modi**'s call for reducing fuel consumption and postponing gold purchases, claiming it is reckless and immoral.  The Prime Minister, meanwhile, urged citizens to use petroleum products judiciously, postpone gold purchases, and adopt alternative modes of transport to strengthen the economy amidst the global crisis.

recent_articles.title: The emerging Rahul Gandhi-Vijay political partnership - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, Congress leader, attended the swearing-in ceremony of **C. Joseph Vijay**'s new **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam** government in Chennai. The event signaled a potential shift in the political landscape between the Congress and the DMK, with **Gandhi** expressing support for **Vijay** and their relationship mirroring that shared by former allies **M.K. Stalin** and **Gandhi**.  The TVK's success may bolster the Congress's influence in southern India.

recent_articles.title: Congress’ wait to join the Tamil Nadu Cabinet continues - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** attended the swearing-in ceremony of **C. Joseph Vijay**, the new Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, on Sunday (May 10, 2026). However, despite the Congress's request for both of its MLAs to be sworn in as Cabinet Ministers at the same time, the **Tamil Nadu Vettri Kazhagam** (TVK) opted to delay the swearing-in. The TVK is planning to include members from other coalition partners like the AIADMK in the cabinet expansion.  The decision not to immediately swear in the Congress MLAs was seen as a missed opportunity by some party leaders who felt it would have sent a strong message of unity.

recent_articles.title: Congress claims Instagram blocked Rahul Gandhi's reel and photo post featuring Vijay due to MeitY rules - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leader Rahul Gandhi's post featuring him and actor-politician Vijay after the Tamil Nadu chief minister's oath-taking ceremony was mistakenly flagged for blocking by **Instagram**, according to **Congress** aide Srivatsa.  He claimed that the action is due to Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) rules, but **MeitY** sources denied this, stating it was a platform error. The post had garnered millions of views before being restored.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool nominates Sobhandeb as Opposition leader, Firhad as Chief Whip - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** nominated **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay**, 82, as the Leader of Opposition in the 18th West Bengal Legislative Assembly.  The party will have two deputy leaders of opposition: **Asima Patra** and **Nayna Bandyopadhya**. **Firhad Hakim** has been appointed as the Trinamool Chief Whip. The decision comes after **Mamata Banerjee** lost her seat in the recent Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Three-hour meeting fails to end impasse over Congress Chief Minister for Kerala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite consultations between **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge, Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, and AICC general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal, senior leaders Ramesh Chennithala and V.D. Satheesan, and KPCC president Sunny Joseph, a decision on naming a Chief Minister for **Kerala** remains stalled.  The high command has until May 23 to finalize the candidate after considering claims from each faction, including those of Congress MLA-designates and constituents of the United Democratic Front (UDF). The consultations were marked by intense posturing and competing claims, with party workers removing aggressive flex boards and appeals made to maintain decorum.

recent_articles.title: Bidar: Take informed decisions about career paths, IAS officer tells students at The Hindu EducationPlus Career Counselling 2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Shinde**, a senior IAS officer and Belagavi Zilla Panchayat CEO, advised students to choose rewarding careers while developing resilience. He emphasized focusing on personal interests and aptitude rather than fleeting trends or job market demands. **Dayananda J.**, CET nodal officer, provided details about the KEA CET examination and counselling.  **Sachin Gudge**, associate professor at Bidar Institute of Medical Sciences, spoke about medicine as a career path. Other speakers included **Vinita Balbhim Patil**, principal of Lingaraj Appa Engineering College, and **Parvat Bijaspur**, CA, who discussed careers in commerce.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM debate: Kharge to hold crucial talks with senior leaders today evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **AICC president**, will meet with key figures in the Kerala Congress leadership, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, and **Ramesh Chennithala**, on Saturday (May 9, 2026) to discuss the selection of a new Chief Minister.  **Rahul Gandhi** is expected to meet with the Kerala leaders after a consensus emerges from the meeting chaired by **Kharge**.

recent_articles.title: Congress seeks discussion in Parliament on China's 'support' to Pakistan in Operation Sindoor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** general secretary (communications) Jairam Ramesh demanded a discussion in Parliament on **China's** claims of providing on-site technical support to Pakistan during Operation Sindoor last year.  Ramesh questioned the government's loosening of investment and trade curbs on China, its deepening industrial dependency, and why Prime Minister Narendra Modi gave a clean chit to China in 2020 after the conflict. He cited **Lt. Gen. Rahul Singh**, Deputy Chief of Army Staff, who had previously revealed details about **China's** involvement.  Ramesh emphasized the need for these issues to be discussed in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Nitish and BJP have no moral right to speak on dynastic politics, says Tejashwi Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the opposition in Bihar's Legislative Assembly, criticized **Nitish Kumar** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for their involvement in dynasty politics following the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet**.  Yadav argued that both the **BJP** and its allies are engaging in dynasty politics, citing examples like the inclusion of sons of former Chief Ministers in the new cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Punjab worse than West Bengal under AAP rule, says Haryana CM Saini - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** criticized the **AAP government in Punjab**, accusing it of failing to control drug trafficking, illegal mining, and lawlessness. He compared the current situation in Punjab to West Bengal under **Mamata Banerjee**, stating that people are disillusioned with the AAP and seeking change through the BJP's governance model.  Saini also contrasted the BJP's policies with those of the Congress, highlighting the latter's corruption and lack of focus on people's welfare.

recent_articles.title: Only Congress party can defeat BJP in the battle of ideologies, says Rahul Gandhi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress**, asserted that only his party could defeat the **BJP**, characterizing the upcoming election as a clash between the **RSS’s** ideology of hatred and partition and the Congress's ideology of love and unity.  He accused **Narendra Modi** of attacking India's democratic system and the Constitution, vowing that the Congress would not forget this action. **Gandhi** also criticized the U.S. trade deal, claiming it harms Indian farmers and was influenced by Mr. Modi’s "entire history" and a pending U.S. criminal case against businessman **Gautam Adani**.  The event marked a show of unity within the faction-ridden Haryana unit, with prominent Congress leaders joining him.

recent_articles.title: Smacks of low political opportunism: Mani Shankar Aiyar slams Congress’ TVK tie-up decision - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Veteran Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar criticized the party's decision to ally with the TVK in Tamil Nadu, calling it "low political opportunism" and a betrayal of its longstanding partnership with the DMK.  Aiyar argued that this move would facilitate the entry of a communal BJP into Tamil Nadu's Dravidian ethos, making it the worst own goal in political history. He expressed deep unease with the Congress' decision to abandon a tried and tested ally, citing Mahatma Gandhi's principles of morality and self-sacrifice. The Congress' decision to join forces with the TVK has been met with disapproval from the DMK, who described it as "backstabbing."

recent_articles.title: 'This is all about election': Immigration attorneys on Ken Paxton's investigation into 30 H-1B 'ghost offices' - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton** announced an investigation into 30 North Texas businesses for alleged H-1B visa fraud, claiming they operate "ghost offices" with no H-1B workers. **Immigration attorneys Rahul Reddy** and **Emily Neumann** criticized the timing of the investigation, suggesting it is politically motivated to target Indian-origin businesses ahead of the upcoming election. They argue that Paxton's actions are fueled by a desire to appease his political rivals and further stoke anti-Indian sentiment in Texas.

recent_articles.title: Kerala election results: Congress high command to pick Kerala CM; most UDF allies for Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress Legislative Party** in Kerala authorized the party high command to choose the next Chief Minister after a resolution was passed.  **AICC** observers, **Mukul Wasnik**, **Ajay Maken**, and **Deepa Dasmunsi**, met with all 63 legislators to gauge their preferences for the position. The three frontrunners in the race are former Leader of Opposition **V.D. Satheesan**, **K.C. Venugopal**, and **Ramesh Chennithala**.  **UDF** allies, including the **IUML**, have indicated support for **Satheesan**, while **KPCC** president **Sunny Joseph** has called for a decision based on public sentiment. The observers will present their findings to the high command, who is expected to make a final call soon.

recent_articles.title: The roller-coaster relationship between the DMK and Congress finally derails - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **DMK** and **Congress**, after a two-decade alliance, have officially ended their partnership.  This decision comes after years of strained negotiations over seat-sharing during elections, culminating in the 2026 Assembly polls where the DMK secured victory. The relationship was marked by tensions and disagreements, particularly regarding portfolio distribution and the treatment of local Congress leaders. Despite a history of shared power and opposition to the BJP, the two parties ultimately decided to part ways.
